title: fix(acpx): bound CPU use for concurrent managed agents
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes excessive thread growth when a high-core Gateway runs concurrent ACP agents.

## User Impact

User impact: shared Gateways keep managed-agent scheduler load predictable; hosts with eight or fewer available CPUs keep their current worker count, and explicit operator overrides remain authoritative.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each managed ACP child owns an independent Tokio runtime that otherwise defaults to every available host CPU. The ACPX service now supplies a child-only worker bound without adding a public configuration surface.

## Evidence

- [Blacksmith Testbox](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35573960240): focused formatting, lint, service tests, and real-process tests passed (31 tests).
- Live deployment verification is deferred until the change reaches a release.
